content_html:
The Sacred Valley of the Incas is one of the most visited destinations near Cusco. This beautiful valley combines stunning Andean landscapes, impressive archaeological sites, and traditional villages full of history. It is also a perfect stop before visiting Machu Picchu.

Must-Visit Villages

Pisac
Famous for its impressive archaeological site and traditional artisan market. From the Inca terraces you can enjoy amazing views of the valley.

Ollantaytambo
One of the best-preserved Inca towns. Its stone streets and impressive fortress make it a unique historical destination.

Chinchero
Known for its traditional textiles and its colonial church built on Inca foundations.

Recommended Tours

  • Classic Sacred Valley Tour: Pisac, Urubamba, Ollantaytambo, and Chinchero.
  • Sacred Valley VIP Tour: Includes Moray and the Maras Salt Mines.
  • Sacred Valley + Machu Picchu Tour: Combines the valley tour with the train journey to Machu Picchu.
